adventures_completion_check.name: adventures_completion_check
adventures_completion_check.value: ("adventures"."status" = 'complete' AND "adventures"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("adventures"."status" <> 'complete' AND "adventures"."completed_at" IS NULL)

personas_approval_check.name: personas_approval_check
personas_approval_check.value: ("personas"."status" = 'ready' AND "personas"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "personas"."deleted_at" IS NULL) OR ("personas"."status" = 'draft' AND "personas"."approved_at" IS NULL AND "personas"."deleted_at" IS NULL) OR ("personas"."status" = 'deleted' AND "personas"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL)
